lines.l: And every night you were guiding me
At night, when I can't fall asleep and it don't really seem to get better
I'm always trying to dream of times we were together
And now your love is my galaxy, with stars will light the way
And every night you were guiding me
And now your love is my galaxy
With stars will light the way
And every night you are guiding me
Feels like in heaven when the night falls
